Name: (CP) Colorful Chairs and Couches
Author: AngelOfStars
Description:
[size=3]Have you ever looked at your farmhouse and thought: What if more color? Well now... more color!

This also makes it so the long couches are in every color! 

You can find the furniture in the general furniture catalogue that you can buy from Robin! ([i]I don't know how to use Calcifer to add a catalogue and I kinda don't want to try to learn how so..[/i].)

[size=3]You can also use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url] and type in "Colorful" to find the furniture.[/size]

This is an updated version of my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12695]Custom Furniture Mod[/url] (from ye olden 1.5 days) - the Alternative Textures version can still be found there.

This Mod [i]ADDS[/i] the couches as new furniture!

Installation:
[size=3]1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
2. Install this mod.
3. Extract all and drop them into your Mods folder.[/size]

If you have any other colors that you would want just let me know :) I'll consider adding it

[size=3]For Translators: 
You may upload your translation file to Nexus, just be sure to make this mod a requirement + don't upload the actual code![/size]

[/size][size=3]If you like the stuff I make, consider sending me a [url=https://ko-fi.com/lilydoesthingssometimes]ko-fi[/url]﻿ - never required of course, I do this stuff for fun, but it does make it easier to focus on making things.[/size][size=3]

[/size]Credits: 
Just Concerned Ape because I would not know where to start with pixel art with out him :)
